newsitem.title: USA: Reynolds and Reynolds in $30 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds and Reynolds in $30 mln contract.

text.p: Reynolds and Reynolds Co said on Wednesday that it signed a five-year, $30 million contract with holding company First Chicago NBD.
Under the agreement, Reynolds will manage an outsourcing program for First Chicago, including forms analysis, printing, electronic requisitioning and warehousing.

"Reynolds will help us reduce our forms business expense, which is an integral part of our goal of saving $100 million annually through strategic sourcing," said Grace Thompson, vice president for First Chicago.
Reynolds and Reynolds provides information management systems related to automobile, healthcare and business markets.
